national_raw_news.title: Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar for 2024 & 2025 conferred on 106 young artists in perform...
national_raw_news.content: Union Culture and Tourism Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat today said that the vision of Viksit Bharat cannot be realised through good infrastructure and materialistic progress alone, but art, culture and heritage will play a vital role in it. Addressing the Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puruskar Ceremony in New Delhi, the Minister said that the soul and true identity of India lies in its cultural traditions and heritage. Mr Shekhawat said that the country is undergoing an era of transformation, with its identity and stature gaining recognition across the world. He noted that artists have a significant role to play in this transformation. The Minister highlighted the contribution of generations of artists who have sustained India’s cultural traditions despite many hardships. Mr Shekhawat conferred the Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar by the Sangeet Natak Akademi for the years 2024 and 2025 to 106 young artists from across the country in the field of performing arts. Rajasthan’s Akram Khan Behrupiya received the puraskar for folk dance, Bihar’s Manisha Srivastava for Folk music, while Hito Kiho from Nagaland was honoured for Choir music. Subhashree Swain was conferred the puraskar for Chhau dance and Ghanshyam Sahu was given the award for Playwriting. Talking to Akashvani News, theatre actor and director Dr Anand Kumar Pandey expressed his happiness over his achievement. He said that theatre is a lifelong commitment and is determined to continue contributing to the field of acting, direction and writing. Dr Pandey said that he is working towards creating better opportunities for emerging artists across Chhattisgarh.

national_raw_news.title: French President Macron rejects Interior Minister Laurent Nunez’s resignation amid protests...
national_raw_news.content: French President Emmanuel Macron has expressed concern over security failures that led to violent protests across the country but rejected the resignation of Interior Minister Laurent Nunez amid the crisis. According to local media reports, at least 2,400 people have been arrested following the unrest, during which town halls were set on fire and hundreds of businesses were looted or damaged. The Elysee Palace, the official residence of the president of France, said Nunez had submitted his resignation yesterday, but the President refused to accept it, citing the need for continued leadership of law enforcement during the crisis. Macron directed the Interior Minister to ensure transparency over the planning and intelligence failures that led to the violence and introduce new operational methods for security forces. The protests followed calls by labour unions, student organisations and activists. According to local media, authorities estimated that around 5 Lakh 50 thousand people took part in Saturday’s largely peaceful marches, while organisers put the figure at 8 Lakh. On Sunday, Macron expressed anger and shame over the rioting and looting during nationwide demonstrations. The French President also announced measures to address economic concerns, including rising fuel prices and the cost of living, and pledged firm legal action against those involved in the violence.

national_raw_news.title: Telangana Governor attends Saddula Bathukamma celebrations in Hyderabad 4 hours ago 71
national_raw_news.content: Telangana Governor Shiva Pratap Shukla has said Telangana is the birthplace of dreams. The Governor and his wife attended the Saddula Bathukamma celebrations on Tank Bund on Sunday as chief guests. He extended heartfelt greetings to Telangana people at home and abroad. He described Bathukamma as a living symbol of Telangana’s rich cultural heritage, women’s strength and deep reverence for nature. He praised the mothers and sisters who have preserved this tradition for generations. Referring to global climate challenges such as El Niño, the Governor noted that the state has received lower rainfall this year. He called it a clear warning and cautioned that indiscriminate use of natural resources could lead to a severe water crisis. The Governor said protecting nature and water is the truest form of worship. He urged every citizen to treat water conservation as a first duty rather than only a government responsibility and to stop water wastage immediately. He stressed rainwater harvesting, protection of tanks and ponds, and recharging of groundwater. He also appealed to farmers to give priority to crops that need less water and suit local conditions. Ministers Jupally Krishna Rao and Seethakka also spoke on the significance of the festival. Film actors Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika, consuls general of the United States and Germany, and senior officials took part.
